description: CR 614.1b Eon Hub replaces the upkeep step with nothing
note: Eon Hub is bob's and alice's upkeep is skipped: "players skip their upkeep steps" is not scoped to its controller. A step replaced with nothing never begins (CR 614.6), so Sarcomancy's upkeep trigger never reaches the stack, rather than resolving to nothing; CR 500.11 proceeds past the upkeep only, to the draw step. Turn 2, so CR 103.8a does not skip the draw step too. cr-500-6-without-a-skip-the-upkeep-step-begins-and-its-trigger-fires is the control.
